title.original: SOP: A Scalable Online Post-Training System for Vision-Language-Action Models
title.zh: SOP：面向视觉—语言—动作模型的可扩展在线后训练系统
title.en: SOP: A Scalable Online Post-Training System for Vision-Language-Action Models

inclusion_reason.zh: SOP 将机器人机群、数据流、人类干预、云端学习和策略发布闭成可复用的真实世界在线后训练系统。
inclusion_reason.en: SOP closes robot fleets, data streaming, human intervention, cloud learning, and policy deployment into a reusable real-world online post-training system.

abstract.zh: SOP 把机器人机群的真实执行、人类干预和云端学习闭合成在线后训练循环，让通用视觉—语言—动作策略在多任务物理环境中持续更新。
abstract.en: SOP closes the loop between robot-fleet execution, human intervention, and cloud learning so a general vision-language-action policy can be updated online across real-world tasks.

problem.zh: 现有 VLA 后训练多为离线、单机器人或单任务，无法高效收集同策略经验，也难在适应专门技能时保持通用能力。
problem.en: Existing VLA post-training is largely offline, single-robot, or task-specific, limiting on-policy experience collection and making it hard to preserve generality during specialization.

approach.zh: 多台机器人并行流式上传轨迹和人类纠正，中心学习器异步更新共享策略再下发机群；系统可承载交互模仿学习或强化学习算法。
approach.en: Multiple robots stream trajectories and human corrections to a central learner, which asynchronously updates and redistributes a shared policy; the system can host interactive imitation or reinforcement learning.

system_design.zh: 边缘执行器记录观测、动作和干预信号，数据通道汇聚到云端训练器，策略发布服务进行版本化下发，各机器人继续采集新同策略数据。
system_design.en: Edge executors record observations, actions, and intervention signals; a data plane aggregates them at the cloud trainer, and versioned policy serving redistributes updates for continued on-policy collection.

key_results.zh: 真实操作任务中，机群在线后训练提升了预训练 VLA 的任务熟练度，同时维持单一多任务策略，经验收集随机器人数量近似扩展。
key_results.en: On real manipulation tasks, fleet-based online post-training improves pretrained VLA proficiency while retaining one multi-task policy, with experience collection scaling approximately with fleet size.

limitations.zh: 真实机器人数据昂贵且有安全风险，中心学习器和网络可能成为故障点；结果来自有限硬件与任务，近线性扩展未必延伸到更大机群。
limitations.en: Real-robot data is costly and safety critical, the central learner and network can fail, and results from limited hardware and tasks may not preserve near-linear scaling in larger fleets.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
